summary: BioHarvest Sciences Inc., a British Columbia-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, TASE and Frankfurt (FSE: 8MV0), furnished a Form 6-K containing an Exhibit 99.1 news release dated September 15, 2026, announcing the launch of single-dose VINIA Daily Chews, a chewable delivery format delivering 400 mg of its proprietary red-grape cell composition. The filing is a routine product-launch disclosure, not a special situation: it states no transaction, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation or regulatory clock. What to watch is commercial execution—format expansion, demographic reach and retention—rather than any arbitrage angle.
